sources.snippet: Character-based RNN-T model. The total parameter count is 159.34M. This model utilizes an enhanced Transformer architecture called Zipformer. The training recipe is available on k2-fsa/icefall. Note that this model can process Japanese audio clips up to ~30 seconds.
